results.question: Which product category brings in the most money from delivered orders, and how much?
results.gold_sql: SELECT t.product_category_name_english, SUM(oi.price) AS rev FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN product_category_name_translation t ON p.product_category_name = t.product_category_name WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY rev DESC LIMIT 1
results.pred_sql:
SELECT 
    COALESCE(t.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name) AS product_category,
    SUM(oi.price) AS total_revenue
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
LEFT JOIN product_category_name_translation t ON p.product_category_name = t.product_category_name
WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
GROUP BY product_category
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC
LIMIT 1;

results.question: How many customers have ordered more than once, and what percentage of all customers is that?
results.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*), 100.0 * COUNT(*) / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_unique_id) FROM customers) FROM (SELECT c.customer_unique_id FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) > 1)
results.pred_sql:

  SUM(CASE WHEN order_count > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS repeat_customers_count,
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN order_count > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS repeat_customers_percentage
FROM (

  FROM customers c
  JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id

results.question: Which 5 states have the slowest average delivery time in days, counting delivered orders only?
results.gold_sql: SELECT c.customer_state, AVG(julianday(o.order_delivered_customer_date) - julianday(o.order_purchase_timestamp)) AS d FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY d DESC LIMIT 5
results.pred_sql:
SELECT c.customer_state, 
       AVG(JULIANDAY(o.order_delivered_customer_date) - JULIANDAY(o.order_purchase_timestamp)) AS avg_delivery_days
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' 
  AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL 
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY c.customer_state
ORDER BY avg_delivery_days DESC
LIMIT 5;

results.question: For each month of 2017, show delivered revenue and how much it changed compared with the previous month.
results.gold_sql: SELECT m, rev, rev - LAG(rev) OVER (ORDER BY m) AS change FROM (SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS m, SUM(oi.price) AS rev FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' AND strftime('%Y', o.order_purchase_timestamp) = '2017' GROUP BY m)
results.pred_sql:
SELECT 
    strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_delivered_customer_date) AS month,
    SUM(oi.price + oi.freight_value) AS delivered_revenue,
    SUM(oi.price + oi.freight_value) - LAG(SUM(oi.price + oi.freight_value)) OVER (ORDER BY strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_delivered_customer_date)) AS revenue_change
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
  AND o.order_delivered_customer_date LIKE '2017%'
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month;

results.question: Which month of 2017 had the most first-time customers, and how many?
results.gold_sql: SELECT m, COUNT(*) AS n FROM (SELECT c.customer_unique_id, strftime('%Y-%m', MIN(o.order_purchase_timestamp)) AS m FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id) WHERE m LIKE '2017-%' GROUP BY m ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 1
results.pred_sql:
SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS month, COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_unique_id) AS first_time_customers
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE c.customer_unique_id IN (
    SELECT c2.customer_unique_id
    FROM customers c2
    JOIN orders o2 ON c2.customer_id = o2.customer_id
    GROUP BY c2.customer_unique_id
    HAVING MIN(o2.order_purchase_timestamp) >= '2017-01-01' AND MIN(o2.order_purchase_timestamp) < '2018-01-01'
)
AND strftime('%Y', o.order_purchase_timestamp) = '2017'
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY first_time_customers DESC
LIMIT 1;

results.question: For each year, which product category earned the most revenue from delivered orders, and how much?
results.gold_sql: SELECT yr, cat, rev FROM (SELECT strftime('%Y', o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS yr, t.product_category_name_english AS cat, SUM(oi.price) AS rev, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY strftime('%Y', o.order_purchase_timestamp) ORDER BY SUM(oi.price) DESC) AS rn FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN product_category_name_translation t ON p.product_category_name = t.product_category_name WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' GROUP BY yr, cat) WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY yr
results.pred_sql:
SELECT 
    strftime('%Y', o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS year,
    COALESCE(t.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name) AS product_category,
    SUM(oi.price) AS total_revenue
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
LEFT JOIN product_category_name_translation t ON p.product_category_name = t.product_category_name
WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
GROUP BY year, product_category
HAVING total_revenue = (
    SELECT MAX(sub_rev)
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            SUM(oi2.price) AS sub_rev
        FROM orders o2
        JOIN order_items oi2 ON o2.order_id = oi2.order_id
        JOIN products p2 ON oi2.product_id = p2.product_id
        WHERE strftime('%Y', o2.order_purchase_timestamp) = strftime('%Y', o.order_purchase_timestamp)
          AND o2.order_status = 'delivered'
        GROUP BY COALESCE(
            (SELECT t2.product_category_name_english FROM product_category_name_translation t2 WHERE t2.product_category_name = p2.product_category_name),
            p2.product_category_name
        )
    )
)
ORDER BY year;
